jp_verse: 湖面に　二つの日が静かに並び\n\n    霧の谷だけが　光を留めていた
en_verse: Two suns rested quietly upon the lake,\nwhile only the misty valley held their light.

jp_verse: 夕暮れの鐘楼に　釣り鐘が吊る\n\n    静かな光だけが　声を包んでいた
en_verse: In the belfry at dusk the temple bell hung still,\nwhile only the quiet light wrapped around its voice.

jp_verse: 三つの水晶が　机の上に置かれ\n\n    棱の光だけが　森へ溢れていた
en_verse: Three crystals rested upon the wooden table,\nwhile only their faceted light spilled toward the forest.

jp_verse: 三つの碗が　重ねて置かれ\n\n    障子の光だけが　金を温めていた
en_verse: Three bowls were stacked upon the table,\nwhile only the shoji light warmed their metal.

jp_verse: 二つの碗が　空中に並び\n\n    縦の隙間だけが　姿を支えていた
en_verse: Two bowls aligned in midair one above the other,\nwhile only the vertical gap between them held their form.

jp_verse: 朝の平原に　一本の柱が立ち\n\n    水の十字だけが　一日を告げていた
en_verse: Upon the morning plain a single post stood tall,\nwhile only the cross of water heralded the day.

jp_verse: 山の端から　朝日が顔を出し\n\n    池の柱だけが　影を留めていた
en_verse: From behind the mountain's edge the sun appeared,\nwhile only the post in the pond kept its shadow.

jp_verse: 幾世代も　同じ湖を照らし\n\n    黄金の霧だけが　岸を包んでいた
en_verse: For countless generations the same lake was lit,\nwhile only the golden mist wrapped the shoreline.

jp_verse: 静かな部屋に　碗から光が溢れ\n\n    夕の山だけが　窓の外に続いた
en_verse: In the quiet room light overflowed from the bowl,\nwhile only the evening mountains continued beyond the window.

jp_verse: 水平線から　朝日が顔を出し\n\n    空の余白だけが　光を迎えていた
en_verse: From the horizon the morning sun showed its face,\nwhile only the open sky welcomed the light.

jp_verse: 碗の上に　一滴が静止し\n\n    黄金の光だけが　部屋を満たしていた
en_verse: Above the bowl a single drop hung motionless,\nwhile only its golden light filled the room.

jp_verse: 夕の谷底に　川が大きく曲がり\n\n    光の帯だけが　山を越えて続いた
en_verse: Through the evening valley the river curved wide,\nwhile only the band of light continued across the mountains.

jp_verse: 三日月の碗が　机の上で光り\n\n    窓の夕景だけが　窪みを映していた
en_verse: The crescent bowl glowed upon the wooden table,\nwhile only the sunset through the window mirrored its hollow.

jp_verse: 舟形の碗が　机の上で膨らみ\n\n    内側の光だけが　影を押し上げた
en_verse: The boat-shaped bowl swelled upon the table,\nwhile only the light within pushed the shadow upward.

jp_verse: 古い窓辺に　夕日が差し込み\n\n    削れた壁だけが　年月を留めていた
en_verse: Sunset light streamed through the aged window,\nwhile only the worn walls kept the passing years.

jp_verse: 窓辺の台に　光る球が置かれ\n\n    一人の静けさだけが　部屋に在った
en_verse: Upon the ledge by the window a glowing sphere rested,\nand only a solitary stillness remained in the room.

jp_verse: 白い花束が　窓辺に置かれ\n\n    夕焼けだけが　花びらを染めていた
en_verse: A bouquet of white flowers rested by the window,\nwhile only the sunset stained the petals.

jp_verse: 折り紙の鶴が　木の盆に溢れ\n\n    夕光だけが　百の翼を照らした
en_verse: Origami cranes overflowed the wooden tray,\nwhile only the evening light lit a hundred wings.

jp_verse: 光る球の　中央を光が貫き\n\n    縦の筋だけが　静けさを留めていた
en_verse: Light passed through the center of the glowing sphere,\nwhile only a vertical line held the stillness.

jp_verse: 廊下の天井に　千の鶴が吊る\n\n    尽きぬ光だけが　奥へ続いていた
en_verse: From the corridor ceiling a thousand cranes hung down,\nwhile only the endless light continued toward the back.
